device_entry.name: 仿真场景组件
tags: 机器人动力学与控制仿真实验
device_entry.description: 这是一个非物理软件组件，用于定义、编译、初始化和更新仿真场景。它管理场景规格、实体、传感器、地形、多环境布局及共享传感上下文，并可将场景 XML 与网格资源导出到目录或压缩包，供实验或机器人仿真使用。
device_entry.description_en: This is a non-physical software component for defining, compiling, initializing, and updating a simulation scene. It manages scene specifications, entities, sensors, terrain, multi-environment layout, and shared sensor context, and can export scene XML and mesh assets to a directory or archive for laboratory or robotics simulation use.

schema.description: 编译仿真场景规格以生成可用于仿真的场景。
schema.description_en: Compile the simulation scene specification into a scene usable by the simulator.

schema.description: 将场景 XML 和网格资源写入目录，或导出为压缩包。
schema.description_en: Write the scene XML and mesh assets to a directory, or export them as an archive.

schema.description: 将场景导出为压缩包（已弃用）。
schema.description_en: Export the scene as a zip archive (deprecated).

schema.description: 获取各仿真环境的原点位置。
